brief: Create a shared-payment agreement that identifies amount, responsibility and review date.

title.pt-BR: Deixe o acordo de pagamentos claro

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Payment Agreements"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Aclara el acuerdo de pagos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Deixe o acordo de pagamentos claro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Create a shared-payment agreement that identifies amount, responsibility and review date.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A shared bill needs an owner for each action, a clear amount and a date to revisit the plan.
instruction.misconception: A vague promise to help is a complete payment agreement, or review means a silent unilateral change.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Write who contributes what and when, who makes the payment, and when both will review changes.
A usable agreement states how much each person contributes.
Saving contributions and sending payment are different actions.
The first agreement identifies responsibility and a review time.
Early communication allows a shared response to the gap.
A review date creates a chance to update the agreement.
A review date helps the arrangement respond to changed costs.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
